title: Bianchi groups and automorphisms of rank-four $K3$ surfaces
summary: We relate the arithmetic of Bianchi groups to automorphism groups of Picard-rank-four $K3$ surfaces. Let $K$ be an imaginary quadratic field with ring of integers $\mathcal O_K$, and let $S_K=\operatorname{Herm}_2(\mathcal O_K)$ be the rank-four lattice of $2\times2$ Hermitian matrices over $\mathcal O_K$, equipped with the quadratic form $2\det$. For an odd integer $N\geq1$, we consider a very general $S_K(2N)$-polarized $K3$ surface $X_{K,2N}$.
